python3 .prflow/tmp/tripwire.py > .prflow/tmp/tripwire-base.json 2>&1; wc -l .prflow/tmp/tripwire-base.json; echo "=== literal count ==="; python3 -c "import json;print(len(json.load(open('.prflow/tmp/tripwire-base.json'))))"

cd skills/review
echo "== 1 config_only 0.5 =="; grep -rl "small_diff" phases/ SKILL.md
echo "== 2 rule 4a CAVEAT =="; grep -rln "APPROVE WITH CAVEAT\|checklist.*fail\|rule 4a\|4a" phases/

timeout 60 python3 .prflow/tmp/tripwire.py | tee .prflow/tmp/tripwire-now.json | python3 -c "
import json,sys
now=json.load(sys.stdin)
base=json.load(open('.prflow/tmp/tripwire-base.json'))
for k in sorted(set(base)|set(now)):
    b=base.get(k,{}); n=now.get(k,{})
    if b!=n:
        # only show if the SKILL.md count dropped to something that could matter
        print('CHANGED', repr(k), '| base', b, '| now', n)
"

for tok in checklist_skipped config_only engine_self_modifying has_new_types small_diff "type-design-analyzer" "pr-test-analyzer" classified; do
  echo "=== $tok ==="
  grep -nE "REVIEW_ROOT|REVIEW_SKILL" lib/test/run.sh | grep -F "$tok"

done

git diff main...HEAD -- scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json && echo "===SHA COMPUTE===" && for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-1-7-stale-adjudication.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-4-github-post.md; do echo "$f: $(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; for t in 'finalize_check' '60 pull requests' 'honored-but-dead' 'Common Mistakes' 'engine_self_modifying' 'producer emits it now'; do echo "=== $t ==="; grep -rnF "$t" lib/test/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; done

for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-1-7-stale-adjudication.md skills/review/phases/phase-4-4-github-post.md; do printf "%s  " "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; echo "$f"; done

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py mark-running --flight "$FK" --token "$TK" 2>&1
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py finish --flight "$FK" --token …[per-command-truncated]
